eligibility.title: Eligibility check
eligibility.action: Verify age 18–39 (DOB 1986-10-27 through 2008-10-26), no imprisonment-level criminal record, no forced deportation/departure from Korea, no travel-ban reason, no color blindness/color weakness, and prior E-9/E-10 stay under the official limit.

registration.title: Point System application
registration.action: The current application period is 2026-10-26 through 2026-10-30 via the SLBFE website. SLBFE says to check its website on 2026-10-12 for instructions on completing applications.

exam_fee.title: EPS-TOPIK application fee
exam_fee.action: Official fee: US$28, stated as LKR 9,250 in the current notice. Follow only SLBFE's official payment instructions.

biometric.title: Identity verification
biometric.action: Use the current SLBFE/HRD Korea identity-verification requirements. KEP does not invent a separate biometric step beyond the official notice.

document_verify.title: Application document verification
document_verify.action: Prepare the official application form, passport copy, recent photo file and payment slip. Identity data must match the passport and key personal details cannot be changed after application.

exam_card.title: Test date / venue notice
exam_card.action: SLBFE's current timeline sets 2026-11-16 for announcement of test requirements/date and venue information. Individual test dates are published on the SLBFE website.

eps_topik.title: EPS-TOPIK — Round 1
eps_topik.action: Round 1 uses UBT from 2026-11-25 onward, with the overall period extending into March 2027 subject to change. EPS-TOPIK has 40 multiple-choice questions: 20 reading + 20 listening, total 50 minutes.

skill_competency.title: Skills Test — Round 2
skill_competency.action: Only Round 1 passers proceed. The mandatory Skills Test includes physical fitness, interview and basic skills testing; Job Capacity Assessment can add points from verified experience/training/education/qualifications.

final_selection.title: Point-based final selection
final_selection.action: Final successful candidates are selected by combined Round 1 and Round 2 scores, up to the industry quota. Candidates scoring below 60% of the Skills Test maximum are screened out.

psychology_pre_job.title: Country-specific pre-job checks
psychology_pre_job.action: No separate Sri Lanka psychology stage is asserted from the current point-system notice. Do not copy Indonesia-specific psychology requirements.

mcu1.title: Medical examination
mcu1.action: Final successful candidates must still satisfy Korea employment medical criteria. Exact current post-selection medical dates/providers are published separately by SLBFE.

job_application.title: Job-seeker registration
job_application.action: Final successful candidates may qualify for the job-seekers roster after required medical and document checks. The exact current candidate-file instructions must follow SLBFE's post-selection notice.

roster.title: EPS Job Seekers' Roster
roster.action: Final successful candidates are qualified to be included in the job-seekers roster, but inclusion does not guarantee employment in Korea.

employer_selection.title: Korean employer selection
employer_selection.action: Wait for employer selection through the official EPS process. A broker cannot guarantee employer selection.

slc.title: Standard Labour Contract (SLC)
slc.action: If selected by a Korean employer, follow the current SLBFE instructions for job agreement/SLC and next steps.

post_slc_requirements.title: Post-SLC Sri Lanka requirements
post_slc_requirements.action: Follow only current SLBFE notices for medical schedules, police report, bond/agreement, training, visa and departure preparation.

visa_docs.title: Visa document package
visa_docs.action: Use SLBFE's current visa application instructions and current job-agreement-specific requirements. Exact current charges and appointment details remain notice-specific.

predeparture_training.title: Pre-departure training
predeparture_training.action: Complete SLBFE's official pre-departure training assigned to selected Korea-bound workers.

mcu3_departure.title: Final medical/departure readiness
mcu3_departure.action: Use SLBFE's current medical schedule for agreement-signed / CCVI-received job seekers. Do not invent an Indonesia-style MCU-III stage.

departure.title: Official departure
departure.action: Travel only after official agreement, visa, training, medical and departure arrangements are completed through SLBFE/EPS.

korea_entry_training.title: Korea entry + employment education
korea_entry_training.action: After entry, complete the official Korea-side employment education and handover process.

employer_handover.title: Employer handover
employer_handover.action: Confirm workplace, accommodation and emergency contacts during official handover.

residence_registration.title: Residence Card / foreigner registration
residence_registration.action: After arrival, follow current Korea Immigration rules for foreigner registration / Residence Card.

eps_insurance_check.title: EPS insurance check
eps_insurance_check.action: Confirm required EPS insurance obligations through official EPS information.

first_payroll_check.title: First payroll check
first_payroll_check.action: Compare the first payslip and bank deposit with the SLC, working hours, deductions and applicable wage rules.

labor_support_ready.title: Labor support readiness
labor_support_ready.action: Keep official labor-support routes and contract/payroll evidence ready for any wage or labor issue.

employment_maintenance.title: Employment / workplace-change readiness
employment_maintenance.action: If a legally recognized workplace-change reason occurs, use Korea's official EPS or employment-center process and observe applicable deadlines.
